name: Hoshi no Ginka
source:
Satsuki is taking part in a big play at her school.
However, the contents of it were incredibly embarrassing.
She worked hard, but on the day of the event, something even more embarrassing happens!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE254311.html]DLsite English[/url]]
